• Brew 1 Lingering Potion of Regeneration II.
• Brew 1 Lingering Potion of Weaving.
• Brew 1 Lingering Potion of Wind Charging.

Complete all three brews in any order in a swamp during rain at night. Place each final ingredient into the brewing stand yourself.
This task can only be completed once.
task.taskbound.wizard.catalog.5_02_arcan:
• Apply Sharpness IV+, Looting II+, and Unbreaking III to the same 1 diamond sword during this task.
• Then brew 1 Potion of Strength II.
• Brew 1 Potion of Fire Resistance.
• Hand in that 1 diamond sword at a Task Board.
• Hand in 1 Potion of Strength II brewed for this task.
• Hand in 1 Potion of Fire Resistance brewed for this task.

Finish enchanting the sword before brewing. Brew the two potions in either order, placing their final ingredients yourself. Submit the sword and both potions together at a Task Board; they are consumed only when the claim succeeds.
This task can only be completed once.
task.taskbound.hunter.catalog.5_01_the_a: Defeat 8 wither skeletons inside a Nether Fortress with a Smite IV-or-better iron sword while under Strength II. Then return to a Task Board without dying after the first qualifying kill. Use the same physical sword throughout; the no-death window runs from the first qualifying kill until claim.
task.taskbound.hunter.catalog.5_02_the_c:
• Defeat 3 shulkers in an End City while levitating and using a crossbow.
• Then defeat 1 enderman in that same End City.

Stay within the same End City structure boundary until both objectives are complete. Crossbow and Levitation are required only for the shulkers.
This task can only be completed once.

• Craft 1 calibrated sculk sensor inside that Ancient City while under Night Vision.
• Then place the 1 lodestone you crafted inside that city.

Craft both blocks in either order before placing them. Place them in either order in the same Ancient City. Do not awaken a Warden during this task.
This task can only be completed once.
task.taskbound.crafting.catalog.5_02_the:

This task can only be completed once.
